name: SKPRES
recent: SKP Resources 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间持续进行股份回购，并有多份关于 Lembaga Tabung Haji 股权变动的申报。公司在 2026 年 9 月 24 日举行了第 26 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。最新财报显示 2026 年 6 月季度营收环比增长 10.9%，但同比仍下降 34.1%，且录得净亏损。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 9 月 24 日举行第 26 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获股东通过。
公司在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次进行股份回购。
Lembaga Tabung Haji 在 2026 年 10 月多次申报其股权变动。
risks: 最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）录得净亏损 381.8 万令吉，净利率为 -1.1%。
营收同比大幅下降 34.1%，净亏损同比扩大 114.0%。
董事总经理 Gan Poh San 在闭锁期前表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3.382 亿令吉，环比增长 10.9%，但同比下降 34.1%；净亏损为 381.8 万令吉，净利率 -1.1%，较上一季度的 -12.2% 有所收窄，但净亏损同比扩大 114.0%。

recent_en: The company held its 26th Annual General Meeting on 24 September 2026, where all resolutions were approved. The latest financial results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 showed revenue up 10.9% QoQ but down 34.1% YoY, with a net loss recorded.
notable_en: The company held its 26th Annual General Meeting on 24 September 2026, with all resolutions approved by shareholders.
Lembaga Tabung Haji filed several notifications of changes in its shareholding in October 2026.
risks_en: The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) recorded a net loss of MYR 3.818 million, with a net margin of -1.1%.
Revenue declined significantly by 34.1% YoY, and net loss widened by 114.0% YoY.
Managing Director Gan Poh San indicated an intention to deal in securities ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 338.2 million, up 10.9% QoQ but down 34.1% YoY; net loss was MYR 3.818 million with a net margin of -1.1%, an improvement from -12.2% in the previous quarter, though net loss widened by 114.0% YoY.
